title: The Christmas Charade
description: Facing another dull Christmas alone, sparks fly when a risk-averse librarian accidentally gets wrapped up with a grinchy FBI agent in an undercover mission to save the Heart of Christmas.

title: A Magical Christmas Village
description: A woman tells her young granddaughter, Chloe, that her miniature Christmas village can magically grant holiday wishes. As Chloe begins setting up the figurines, real-life events seem to mimic the scenes she creates.

title: One December Night
description: Two music managers must put their history aside to oversee the televised reunion performance of their rock star fathers with a fractured past.

title: A Season for Miracles
description: A woman (Carla Gugino) tries to save her sister's (Laura Dern) children from foster care by taking them to a small town where she is mistaken for a missing heiress.

title: A Gift to Remember
description: A hopeless romantic, Darcy, insists on being swept off her feet. One day, while bicycling to work, Darcy crashes into a sharply dressed man walking his dog. He falls into a coma; she takes the dog home, waiting to reunite him with his owner.

title: Cherished Memories: A Gift to Remember 2
description: As Darcy and Aiden prepare to celebrate their second Christmas together, an unexpected guest and a fight to save the beloved community center unites everyone for an unforgettable holiday.

title: Mistletoe Murders: Don't Fear the Wreather
description: Emily and Sam investigate a wreathmaker who's accused of killing her husbands, while Violet and June nominate Emily for town Cheerman in hopes of convincing her to stay in Fletcher's Grove.

title: Northern Lights of Christmas
description: Life deals Zoey Hathaway a strange blow when she inherits a reindeer farm and becomes buried in taking care of the animals and all the Christmas responsibilities.

title: The Royal Nanny
description: Working undercover as a nanny, an MI5 agent must resist the charms of Prince Colin while keeping the royal family safe during Christmastime.

title: Christmas in Evergreen: Tidings of Joy
description: A skeptical writer shows up in Evergreen to get the scoop on the town's famed passion for Christmas during a search for a long-lost time capsule.

title: Trading Up Christmas
description: Michelle tries to get her sister a new place to live and all she has is a Christmas stocking to trade with.

title: My Norwegian Holiday
description: A grieving woman forges a deep connection with a Norwegian man when he discovers she has a troll figurine from his hometown. She soon agrees to accompany him to Norway to uncover the troll's origins and find her own path to healing, love and family.

title: Just in Time for Christmas
description: A young psychology professor has to choose between marrying her longtime beau or accepting a once-in-a-lifetime job. To help her make a decision, a magical messenger lets her see both possible futures so she'll be able to make the right decision.

title: Naughty or Nice
description: Krissy Kringle (Hilarie Burton) receives Santa's naughty or nice book by accident and starts exposing the naughty deeds of people around her.

title: Journey Back to Christmas
description: A nurse from World War II is transported in time to 2016 and meets a man who helps her discover the bonds of family and that the true meaning of Christmas is timeless.

title: Christmas Waltz
description: A woman makes an unexpected connection with her dance instructor after her storybook Christmas wedding is canceled.

title: A December Bride
description: Layla accompanies Seth to her cousin's wedding, and everyone is surprised when she announces they're engaged. They are forced to keep up the pretense, and as they spend more time together, they find themselves feeling something very real.

title: A Blue Ridge Mountain Christmas
description: Hotel manager Willow returns to her stunning Virginia hometown to help her sister plan a Christmas wedding at the inn her family once owned.

title: A Very Merry Bridesmaid
description: Leah's 30th birthday is on Christmas Eve, the same day as her brother's wedding. Her childhood crush is back in town for the ceremony, and he's determined to make sure her special day doesn't go by the wayside.

title: A Shoe Addict's Christmas
description: Department store employee Noelle visits Christmases of past, present and future as her guardian angel helps her navigate her wishes for a connection with her father, her dream career and love.

title: Christmas in Toyland
description: A toy store data analyst tries to save hundreds of jobs right before Christmas to help keep the in-store experience alive.
